# Detailed Sentence-by-Sentence Adjudication & Morphological Cross-Check Report
## Dataset: UD Turkish-BOUN Test Set

**Total Sentences with Disagreements:** 576  
**Total Disputed Tokens Evaluated:** 1097  
**Adjudication Model:** Gemini 3.8 Flash (Temperature 0.0)  
**Cross-Check Data Included:** Full Zemberek Parse (Zemberek format + Oflazer format) and Verbatim CoNLL-U Gold.  

### Summary of Verdicts
| Verdict | Description | Count | Percentage |
|:---|:---|:---:|:---:|
| **ZEMBEREK** | Zemberek was correct (UD/alignment flawed) | 473 | 43.1% |
| **BOTH** | Both are valid linguistic alternatives / twins | 455 | 41.5% |
| **UD** | UD was correct (Genuine Zemberek error) | 139 | 12.7% |
| **NEITHER** | Neither analysis was correct | 30 | 2.7% |
